factSources.text: With the Sun in Aquarius, the core self strengthens through independent thought, social awareness, and the courage to live outside stale expectations. The Sun is in detriment in Aquarius, so identity forms against the group as much as within it. You are here to bring perspective that serves more than the self.

factSources.text: The Sun describes identity, vitality, creative force, visibility, and the part of life that wants to be lived with purpose. It shows where someone builds confidence, recognizes what gives them energy, and learns to act from the center of themselves rather than from imitation or approval. The Sun moves through all twelve signs once each year and spends about one month in each sign. Its sign describes the style of identity and vitality; its house shows where that life force seeks expression and recognition. With your Sun in Aquarius, you embody individuality, innovation, and a deep sense of humanitarianism. You thrive on uniqueness and often seek to challenge the status quo. You shine in situations where you can utilize your inventive mind and make a difference in the world.

eventsDuringTransit.meaning: Identity meets imagination and idealism. Heightened sensitivity, imagination, and a pull toward the ideal. The sextile makes this a natural strength: Imaginative and compassionate; creative and charitable directions come naturally. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.

Identity meets independence and disruption. The urge to be different and to do things your own way. The trine makes this a natural strength: Originality that reads as brilliance or healthy independence. The growth edge is not to coast on the ease.
